posts.author: Colin Kaminski
posts.content_md: You can look at Laser Sams used equipment page. I have bought tons of wierd parts from him and he is great. ebay, of course. A post to alt.lasers can be helpful as well.

posts.author: Joe Farina
posts.content_md:
It seems harder these days to find HeNe power supplies (for the higher-powered ones). I don't think Power Technology is in that business anymore, if they still exist (?)

I also need a power supply for one of my lasers (a SP-107B). The only manufacturer which (to my knowledge) can supply a suitable power supply (operating voltage ~5 kV @ 11.5 mA, start voltage 12 kV plus 6 kV pulse) is Laser Drive.

About a year ago I called them, and although they didn't have one in stock, they could (presuambly) make one, and deliver in about 4 weeks. The price they quoted was $371.52. They are located in the U.S., and the phone number is 724-443-7688.

As Colin mentioned, Sam's and alt.lasers are good places to check.

Thanks for the offer, Vidar.

posts.author: Tony
posts.content_md:
I built a supply for my 107B for under $100 from info on Sam's web page. It has been running fine for over a year now.

As long as you have the ballast resistor, excessive starting voltage won't hurt the tube, as the tube fires before the excessive voltage is reached.

I also have a spare set of parts (capacitors, diodes, oil burner transformer) that I will sell.

Also, I have seen Spectra-Physics 255s going on eBay for around $50 .
